dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000srrc](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000srrc) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 77.167 depth occurred on Apr 21 2026 27km N of Baoknana. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -9.068 longitude 124.0863. It impacted 108209 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
